result.instructions: Tools for Pinecone, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my indexes have the most vectors, and how many namespaces does each one have?"; "Find the 5 vectors most similar to the one stored as 'doc-42' in the support-docs index."; "List the vector ids in the 'faq' namespace that start with 'refund-'.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Pinecone data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run pinecone_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run pinecone_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run pinecone_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. pinecone_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: pinecone_list_indexes
tools.title: List indexes
tools.description: List the indexes in the project with dimension, metric, host, and readiness. Good first call to find an index name. Pinecone API: GET /indexes.

tools.name: pinecone_describe_index
tools.title: Describe an index
tools.description: Get one index: dimension, metric, deployment, status, and the data-plane host. Pinecone API: GET /indexes/{index_name}.

tools.name: pinecone_list_collections
tools.title: List collections
tools.description: List collections (static snapshots of indexes) with size, status, and vector count. Pinecone API: GET /collections.

tools.name: pinecone_describe_collection
tools.title: Describe a collection
tools.description: Get one collection: size, status, dimension, and vector count. Pinecone API: GET /collections/{collection_name}.

tools.name: pinecone_describe_index_stats
tools.title: Index statistics
tools.description: Get vector counts per namespace and index fullness, optionally for vectors that match a metadata filter. Pinecone API: POST /describe_index_stats on the index host.

filter.description: Metadata filter in Pinecone filter syntax, for example {"genre": {"$eq": "documentary"}}.

tools.name: pinecone_list_namespaces
tools.title: List namespaces
tools.description: List the namespaces of an index with their vector counts, one page at a time. Pinecone API: GET /namespaces on the index host.

prefix.description: Only namespaces whose names start with this prefix.

pagination_token.description: Token from the previous page's pagination.next.

tools.name: pinecone_query_vectors
tools.title: Search similar vectors
tools.description: Find the most similar vectors to a query vector, or to a stored vector id, with optional metadata filter. Returns ids, scores, and metadata. Pinecone API: POST /query on the index host.

namespace.description: Namespace inside the index. Omit it for the default namespace.

vector.description: Query vector. Give this or id, not both.

id.description: Search from the stored vector with this id. Give this or vector, not both.

top_k.description: How many matches to return (1-1000, default 10).

filter.description: Metadata filter in Pinecone filter syntax, for example {"genre": {"$eq": "documentary"}}.

include_values.description: Return each match's vector values (default false; large).

tools.name: pinecone_fetch_vectors
tools.title: Fetch vectors by id
tools.description: Fetch stored vectors (values and metadata) by id. Pinecone API: GET /vectors/fetch on the index host.

namespace.description: Namespace inside the index. Omit it for the default namespace.

tools.name: pinecone_list_vector_ids
tools.title: List vector ids
tools.description: List vector ids in a namespace, one page at a time, optionally by id prefix. Ids only, no values. Pinecone API: GET /vectors/list on the index host.

namespace.description: Namespace inside the index. Omit it for the default namespace.

prefix.description: Only ids that start with this prefix.

pagination_token.description: Token from the previous page's pagination.next.

tools.name: pinecone_upsert_vectors
tools.title: Upsert vectors
tools.description: Insert vectors, or replace the values and metadata of vectors that already have the same id. Up to 100 vectors per call. Pinecone API: POST /vectors/upsert on the index host.

namespace.description: Namespace inside the index. Omit it for the default namespace.

values.description: Dense vector values. Length must match the index dimension.

tools.name: pinecone_delete_vectors
tools.title: Delete vectors
tools.description: Delete vectors by id, by metadata filter, or all vectors in a namespace (delete_all). Deletion cannot be undone. Pinecone API: POST /vectors/delete on the index host.

namespace.description: Namespace inside the index. Omit it for the default namespace.

ids.description: Vector ids to delete (1-1000 per call).

filter.description: Metadata filter in Pinecone filter syntax, for example {"genre": {"$eq": "documentary"}}.

delete_all.description: Delete every vector in the namespace. Cannot combine with ids or filter.
